name: Accelia,Inc.
summary: Accelia, Inc. is a holding company that operates as a content distribution services. Its activities include research, development, and delivery of value-added services that utilize content data network; technology consulting; and telecommunication business. The firm specializes in In-House Developed Network Services and System Integration, Contents delivery network, cyber security, DDoS mitigation, IoT services, and system development. The company's services include: CDN services, Global load balancing service, OT Security Services, IT Security Services, Digital Transformation Solutions, IT Security Services and Insurance Services. Accelia was founded on December 1, 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
